scorecard.rationale: The vascular-aging trial counted injurious falls in 14/51 on soybean oil and 17/51 on marine omega-3. Supplement 2 identifies four tested oil lots without a processing grade. This trial excluded Parkinson disease, and the earlier Alzheimer trials used mixed or ambiguous formulations. The refined-oil Parkinson fall-frequency claim remains unresolved. The original TEAM-AD trial provides arm-level fall adverse-event counts and separates events from the proportion of participants affected. The soybean oil capsule accompanied memantine or dual placebo, while active vitamin E replaced it in different regimens. The Alzheimer population, unreported refining grade and nonisolated oil comparison leave the Parkinson fall-frequency direction open. The drug-delivery study uses soybean oil during manufacturing. It gives no isolated culinary oil or falls result.
